text:
maria: quick design check on routing editor: added collapsible mini-map + snapshot scrubber by default. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW-mini-map
sam: nice. mini-map collapsible is great for dense policies. can we persist collapse per-user?
kevin: per-user prefs make sense. also, animation when reordering needs to keep mini-map viewport synced or it feels janky.
maria: leaning per-user. will add animation spec.
ashley: a11y: mini-map needs aria-label + keyboard toggle. when expanded announce groups+viewport. overlay that opens validators must trap focus.
a11y-bot: [automated] checklist: role, aria-label, focusable toggle, focus trap for overlays, escape closes and returns focus.
sam: scrubber default = snapshot steps. add "Play tokens" modal for detailed replay (warn about perf).
kevin: implement token replay via webworker; add /preview?include_fallbacks=1 api for paired diffs. sample response documented in PR.
maria: copy tweak: top-banner from "Policy invalid" -> "Validation found issues  Review fixes". shorter CTA: "Full replay" -> "Play tokens".
ashley: validation badge needs text alt: "Rule failing: missing target" and keyboard shortcut to open pane. add aria-live for reorder announcements.
maria: action items: sam: css/opacity tweak for mini-map hover; kevin: api + focus guard; ashley: a11y checklist; i'll update figma and copy.
sam: will open small PR for css + CTA copy.
kevin: will stub api and add docs.
a11y-bot: [automated] thread summary: collapsible mini-map (per-user), snapshot scrubber default, token replay modal, inline validator overlays, focus management, paired fallback diffs.
